BIRLA INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY, MESRA, RANCHI
(MID SEMESTER EXAMINATION MO/2023)
CLASS: BBA/BCA/BAM   SEMESTER : I
BRANCH: BBA/BCA/BAM   SESSION : MO/2023

SUBJECT: MN103 YOGA
TIME: 02 Hours   FULL MARKS: 25

INSTRUCTIONS:
1. The question paper contains 5 questions each of 5 marks and total 25 marks.
2. Attempt all questions.
3. The missing data, if any, may be assumed suitably.
4. Tables/Data handbook/Graph paper etc., if applicable, will be supplied to the candidates
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------



Q.1(a) When and in which year was the 1st world yoga day celebrated and what was it's theme? [2]
Q.1(b) Definition of asanas and give one example and it's benefits. [3]


Q.2(a) What precautions should be taken before starting yoga? give detail information. [2]
Q.2(b) What is the importance of yoga in physical education and other fields? [3]


Q.3(a) Give 4 benefit of Nari shodhan (Anulom Bilom) pranayama. [2]
Q.3(b) Define Ashtanga yoga. [3]


Q.4(a) How Bhramari pranayama is beneficial for the students. [2]
Q.4(b) What is the historical development of yoga in India? [3]


Q.5(a) What is the balance diet? [2]
Q.5(b) Define meditation and it's effect upon our body? [3]
